sections.heading: Pre-Purchased Additional Baggage Allowance And Excess Baggage
sections.body: We offer a range of Pre-Purchased Additional Baggage Allowance and Excess Baggage options to give you more flexibility, extra space and peace of mind for your journey

sections.heading: Pre-Purchased Additional Baggage And Save

items.title: Flexible Options
items.text: Purchase additional baggage in increments of 5kg, 10kg, 15kg, 20kg, or 25kg to suit your travel needs.

items.title: Convenient Booking
items.text: Add extra baggage at the time of booking as an ancillary add-on, or log in to My Booking if you've already made your reservation.

items.title: Save Money & Time
items.text: Avoid higher airport fees and ensure a smooth check-in experience.

sections.note:
**Important:**
- Booked through a Travel Agent? Please contact your agent for assistance with pre-purchased baggage.
- Availability: Pre-purchased baggage is available up to 24 hours before departure, subject to space availability.

Plan ahead and travel stress-free with Naoero Airlines!

sections.heading: Excess Baggage
sections.body: We understand that sometimes you need to carry more than your standard baggage allowance. Here's what you need to know about excess baggage:

items.title: Payment Options
items.text: Excess Baggage Can Be Paid For At The Airport Or Prepaid Through Your Booking Agent. Please Note That Prepaid Baggage Is Non-Refundable, Even If The Actual Baggage Weight Is Less Than What Was Paid For.

items.title: Check-in Requirements
items.text: If You Are Traveling With Excess Or Overweight Baggage, We Kindly Ask You To Arrive Early To Allow Sufficient Time To Complete Check-In Formalities.

items.title: Packing Guidelines
items.text: For Security And Safety Reasons, Please DO NOT Pack Perishables, Medicines, Or Valuables In Your Excess Luggage.

items.title: Space-Available Basis
items.text: Excess Baggage Is Accepted Only If Space Permits And Is Subject To Aircraft Weight Limits. Fees For Excess Baggage Are Collected At The Airport At The Time Of Check-In.

items.title: Carriage on Next Available Flight
items.text: If We Accept Your Excess Or Overweight Baggage, It May Not Be Transported On The Same Flight As You. We Will Make Every Effort To Send It On The Next Available Flight With Sufficient Load Capacity.

items.title: No Guarantee of Carriage
items.text: Naoero Airlines Cannot Guarantee That Additional Baggage Will Be Transported. Acceptance Is At Our Sole Discretion And Subject To Aircraft Load Constraints.
